why: Knowledge cells pass the four-seed test on the delayed test bed (results/event_lm/knowledge_gap/preregistered.json): ahead of the bed at every finished seed by 0.019 to 0.034, mean 0.026, with 13% fewer threshold cells to hold the parameters. Branching dendrites, apical bursts and racing experts fail.
arm: l2048-know: the saved state of p-forget at 24,000 updates, forked onto windows of 2,048 bytes exactly as l2048-forget was (ctx 2048, batch 2, reads reaching 2,048 cells), with 128 knowledge cells a head grown at the fork (experiments/stack/fork_state.py): their offsets start 8 below a stream cell's charge (e^-8 of its rate), their tags and payloads at the spread of the stream cells' pulses, with no moments of the optimizer; every threshold cell is kept. Trained to 90,000 updates on GPU 1, code at the commit that records this file; l2048-d22 pauses at 75,000 updates for it and resumes after.
reference: l2048-forget, the same fork without knowledge cells: same parent state, seed and data order. Streams at the trained reach: test 1.13667, validation 1.16624; reaching 8,192 cells: 1.12349 / 1.15368; with v15's fast synapses: 1.11994 / 1.15138. tf2048: 1.10669 / 1.13033.

parameters.worth_by_depth_scaling: doubling the stack (depth 11 to 22, 2.0x parameters) gained 0.028 to 0.030 at 72,000 updates; 4.17% more parameters would be worth about 0.002 at that rate

measure: As l2048-forget was scored: both splits of enwik8 as 16 unbroken streams at the trained reach; the reach chosen on the first validation million (trained or 8,192); then with v15's fast synapses on all 11 levels at 2^24; every scoring paired piece by piece against l2048-forget's and tf2048's.
pass_mark: Ahead of l2048-forget by at least 0.005 on both splits at the trained reach, with the paired 95% intervals above zero. Knowledge cells then join the v17 model. The gain is reported beside the 0.002 that 4.17% more parameters would be worth by the depth-scaling slope.
seen_before_recording: Three of the four knowledge seeds finished, the fourth at 6,000 updates 0.012 ahead in the shorter averaged evaluation; no full-size run with knowledge cells exists.

amendment.what: Before any evaluation of l2048-know, and by the standing rule that the spiking model is built, trained and scored as a stream only, the arm is restarted as l2048-know-st: the same fork with training on streams (--stream 10 --stream-groups 15: stretches of ten windows of 2,048 bytes, the state of every read and cell layer handed on from window to window, fifteen groups of streams taking turns). The window-trained l2048-know was stopped after about 25 minutes, before its first evaluation.
amendment.consequence: Against l2048-forget, which trained in windows, the arm now changes two things: knowledge cells and training on streams. The pass mark stays as recorded; the test bed's second laptop screen, also trained on streams, separates the two (a stream-trained bed beside stream-trained knowledge cells). The comparison with tf2048, the Transformer of the same size and training context, is unaffected: the reference may read in windows.

interim_diagnostic.what: The share of every state read's spikes that its knowledge cells take (experiments/knowledge_share.py), for the latest saved weights of l2048-know-st at 37,500 updates, over 8 unbroken validation streams of 4,096 bytes read piece by piece. A diagnostic of the running arm; it changes nothing in the measure or the pass mark.
interim_diagnostic.by_stretch_of_the_stream: every level's share is highest over the first 64 bytes (0.08 to 0.29) and settles from about 512 bytes on (0.04 to 0.18 beyond 2,048)
interim_diagnostic.test_bed_for_comparison: about 0.58 on the delayed test bed, whose heads race 256 stream cells beside their 128 knowledge cells
interim_diagnostic.reading: The grown cells are recruited, so their start far behind the stream cells did not keep them silent. Per candidate they win about as often as on the test bed: 128 knowledge cells are 5.9% of what a head races at a reach of 2,048 cells and take 10.8% of its spikes, against 33% and about 58% on the bed. A reach eight times longer leaves them a smaller part to play.
interim_diagnostic.standing_at_37500_updates: averaged weights on the trainer's streams (about 1.5 KB each): 1.2043 against l2048-forget's 1.2013 at the same update (0.0049 behind at 34,500, 0.0008 at 36,000)
